tools.name: sync_catalog
tools.description: Sync the settlement catalog with export filters (generated)

customer_id.description: Filter results by customer id. This optional parameter corresponds to the customer_id column of the underlying settlement export and is applied before pagination is evaluated. When combined with other filters, customer id participates in server-side AND matching and is recorded in the export audit trail for idempotency.
